property_summary: Withdrawing the entire balance via CashOut must always succeed (balances are deducted before the external call, so a re-entrant re-withdrawal attempt is refused without reverting); the mutant moves the deduction after the call, so the re-entrant callee sees the stale full balance, attempts a second withdrawal, and reverts, leaving the balance non-zero.
change_summary: Move the balance-update statement after the external call, so a reentrant callee observes the caller's pre-withdrawal balance.
